svg.title: Commit constellation: 1165 contributions across 63 active days
svg.desc: A star map where each warm-white star is one day of real GitHub contribution activity; the blue sky matches the profile background and mint marks the longest streak.

g.text: 1165 CONTRIBUTIONS · 63 ACTIVE NIGHTS · 15 STREAK RUNS · 366 DAYS
EACH WHITE STAR = ONE DAY OF ACTIVITY · MINT = LONGEST STREAK
